main.description: G1 INVARIANT — a receipt / certificate produced by a service module. A module ALWAYS emits it UNSIGNED: status is one of the *-unsigned values and serverHeldAuthority is const false. The governing organ (Council 5-of-7 Safe for principal A | the adopting state's own ICAO-PKD / tax-authority key for principal B) signs it through a SEPARATE capability the module never holds. The signed forms (*-signed) are produced ONLY by that external signer (methods/sign_capability.py), never by the module.

status.description: G1 — a MODULE emits only the *-unsigned forms; *-signed is set exclusively by the external governing-organ signer.

serverHeldAuthority.description: G1 INVARIANT — always false, even after external signing (ADR-2605231525).

signerDid.description: set on signing: the Council organ (did:web:etzhayyim.com:council:*) or the adopting state's OWN did — never an etzhayyim platform did for a supplied-to-state act.
